description:
A New Standard for Image Viewers

BandiView is the succeeding image viewer to Honeyview, that inherits everything cool of its predecessor and also gets improved even further. Fast and easy to view images in a variety of formats, from the most common ones to the most professional ones.
- Added support for Adobe HDR JPEG files
- Added an option to apply adaptive HDR tone mapping
- Improved HDR image display to reflect Windows 11 HDR calibration settings
- Improved the loading speed for DNG files and images in archives
- Improved the display of image metadata
- Fixed a bug that prevented some HEIC and DNG images from being displayed correctly
- Fixed a bug that prevented scrolling to the bottom with the keyboard in Webtoon view mode
- Fixed a bug that prevented deleting files with long paths
- Fixed a bug that could cause a different file to open on a NAS
- Fixed security vulnerabilities (KVE-2026-2462, KVE-2026-2465)
- Improved program stability
- Other modifications
